type.description: The design's Type axis; double renders the primary-secondary frame.

setpoint.description: Target setpoint value. undefined = no setpoint marker shown.

newSetpoint.description: Adjustment preview for 2-step interface. When defined, two markers are shown: original (dimmed) + new (focus). Available when setpoint!=undefined.

touching.description: User is physically interacting with the control. Suppresses at-setpoint calculation and triggers focus visual. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

autoAtSetpointDeadband.description: Tolerance for auto at-setpoint detection. Available when setpoint!=undefined && autoAtSetpoint==true.

setpointAtZeroDeadband.description: Tolerance for zero-snap visual state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

setpointOverride.description: Override to derive the setpoint color from the instrument's priority regardless of instrument state. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

animateSetpoint.description: Enable CSS-animated confirm transition. Available when setpoint!=undefined.

secondaryValue.description: Secondary value shown as a thin line arc at the band's inner edge with a second readout (the "primary-secondary" frame type). When undefined (default), the regular single-value frame renders.

state.description: Instrument state (active, loading, off). priority: off also renders the off face.

primaryTickmarkInterval.description: Interval for primary tickmarks in value units. When undefined or <= 0, no primary tickmarks are shown.

secondaryTickmarkInterval.description: Interval for secondary tickmarks in value units. When undefined or <= 0, no secondary tickmarks are shown.

hasReadout.description: When true, shows the center readout (and the secondary readout when the split frame renders — dashed until secondaryValue is set). Default false. Available when large==true.

unit.description: Unit for the in-dial readout (large) and the compact stack rows. Available when hasReadout==true.

name.description: Name row shown under the readout (uppercase overline style). Available when large==true.

faceDiameter.description: Outer-ring diameter in CSS pixels. When set, the instrument renders at a fixed intrinsic size; when unset (default), it fills its container.

large.description: The design's Large variant: alignment-controlled scale labels, in-dial readouts and the name row. When false (default), the Small variant renders — the face cropped to the dial with icon-only center content and a...

tag.description: Identifier line under the compact readout stack, e.g. '#0001'. Available when large==false.

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
